title: Core Conjunctions and Logical Links
lede: Stop joining every idea with وَ. Select the connector that shows the real logical relationship: addition, choice, sequence, contrast, reason or result.
nav: Prepositions with Pronouns and Verb Collocations

items.prompt: Choose the connector that adds equal information.
Choose the connector that presents an alternative.
Choose a sequence with a later next step.
items.feedback: ثُمَّ marks ordered succession, often with some interval.
لكنْ turns to an opposing or limiting point.
لأنّ introduces the cause or explanation.
لذلك points back to a cause and introduces the consequence.

items.prompt: The bus arrived; immediately I boarded it.
items.feedback: فـ expresses the immediate next action.

items.prompt: I like sport, but I do not play every day.
options: أُحِبُّ الرِّيَاضَةَ، لَكِنْ لَا أُمَارِسُهَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
items.feedback: The second idea limits/contrasts with the first.

items.prompt: I stayed home because I was ill.
options: بَقِيتُ فِي الْبَيْتِ لِأَنَّنِي كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا.
بَقِيتُ فِي الْبَيْتِ لَكِنْ كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا.
بَقِيتُ فِي الْبَيْتِ أَوْ كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا.

items.prompt: The train was cancelled; therefore we travelled by bus.
The alarm rang and I immediately woke up.
First we visited the museum; later we ate.
I trained hard, so I improved.
items.feedback: The second clause is a result.

options: Connector choice depends on the relationship.
ثُمَّ and فَـ are always completely interchangeable.

items.prompt: Choose a reason for studying Arabic.
Choose a result of heavy traffic.
options: كَانَتْ حَرَكَةُ الْمُرُورِ شَدِيدَةً، لِذَلِكَ تَأَخَّرْنَا.

items.prompt: Complete: لَمْ أَخْرُجْ ___ الطَّقْسَ كَانَ سَيِّئًا.

items.feedback: The second clause is a result.
فـ often signals immediacy or result.

options: Several accurate links serving different meanings.
One memorised linker repeated in every sentence.
items.feedback: Range must be appropriate and controlled.

options: كَانَ الْمَطَرُ غَزِيرًا، لِذَلِكَ بَقِينَا فِي الْبَيْتِ.
كَانَ الْمَطَرُ غَزِيرًا أَوْ بَقِينَا فِي الْبَيْتِ.
كَانَ الْمَطَرُ غَزِيرًا لَكِنْ بَقِينَا لأن المطر.
items.feedback: The cause and result are explicit.

games.e: فـ links a close next action/result.

blocks: ## Why this matters
Connectors make the relationship between ideas visible. Without them, a reader must guess whether the next sentence adds, contrasts, explains or concludes.
### Core
Use وَ، أَوْ، ثُمَّ، لَكِنْ and لِأَنَّ.
### Develop
Distinguish ثُمَّ, فَـ and لِذَلِكَ by meaning.
### Stretch
Use وَلَكِنَّ accurately before a nominal clause.
[callout] Communication target: Give an opinion, reason, contrasting point and consequence in one connected answer.
## Diagnostic start
Name the relationship before choosing the Arabic word.
## The connector logic map
A varied paragraph is not a paragraph with many different linkers. It is a paragraph in which each linker expresses the intended relationship.

TABLE: Function | Core connector | Model // addition | وَ | أُحِبُّ الْقِرَاءَةَ وَالْكِتَابَةَ. // alternative | أَوْ | هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ الْقِطَارَ أَوِ الْحَافِلَةَ؟ // ordered next step | ثُمَّ | تَنَاوَلْتُ الْفَطُورَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجْتُ. // immediate next step / result | فَـ | وَصَلَتِ الْحَافِلَةُ فَرَكِبْتُهَا. // contrast | لَكِنْ | الطَّقْسُ بَارِدٌ، لَكِنْ سَأَخْرُجُ. // reason | لِأَنَّ | أَدْرُسُ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ لِأَنَّهَا مُهِمَّةٌ. // result | لِذَلِكَ / لِذَا | كَانَ الطَّرِيقُ مُغْلَقًا، لِذَلِكَ تَأَخَّرْنَا.
[callout/warning] Range is not random variety: Replacing every وَ with a more formal word can make the logic worse. Accuracy and appropriateness come first.
## Sequence: ثُمَّ versus فَـ
Both can translate as “then”, but they do not always present the timing in the same way.
[ar] غَسَلْتُ وَجْهِي، ثُمَّ تَنَاوَلْتُ الْفَطُورَ.
[ar] دَقَّ الْجَرَسُ فَدَخَلَ الطُّلَّابُ.
[ar] دَرَسْتُ بِجِدٍّ فَنَجَحْتُ.
[ar] أَوَّلًا خَطَّطْتُ، ثُمَّ كَتَبْتُ، وَأَخِيرًا رَاجَعْتُ.
[callout] Do not force the distinction: Natural usage has overlap. For learners, use ثُمَّ for a clearly ordered later step and فَـ when the next action or result follows closely.
## Contrast with لَكِنْ and وَلَكِنَّ
The simple linker لكنْ can introduce a contrasting clause. ولكنَّ belongs to the إنّ family and affects the following nominal structure.
[ar] الْمَدْرَسَةُ بَعِيدَةٌ، لَكِنْ أُحِبُّهَا.
[ar] الْفِلْمُ طَوِيلٌ، وَلَكِنَّهُ مُثِيرٌ.
[ar] الطَّقْسُ بَارِدٌ، وَلَكِنَّ الشَّمْسَ سَاطِعَةٌ.

[callout/warning] Do not confuse forms: Use لَكِنْ as the straightforward clause linker. Learn common attached forms such as وَلَكِنَّهُ، وَلَكِنَّهَا as useful chunks. Full إنّ-family case behaviour returns in Nominal Sentences.
## Reason and result: two directions
A reason answers “why?”. A result states what happened because of the earlier cause.
[ar] لَمْ أَذْهَبْ لِأَنَّنِي كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا.
[ar] كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا، لِذَلِكَ لَمْ أَذْهَبْ.
[ar] أُحِبُّ التَّعَلُّمَ عَنْ بُعْدٍ لِأَنَّهُ مَرِنٌ.
[ar] الطَّقْسُ جَمِيلٌ، لِذَا سَنَخْرُجُ.

[callout] After لِأَنَّ: Use a noun or attached pronoun as the clause subject: لِأَنَّ الطَّقْسَ... , لِأَنَّهُ... , لِأَنَّنِي... . Do not put a bare independent clause after it without building the structure.
## Misconception and proofreading clinic
Replace connector chains that obscure the logic.

TABLE: Weak / inaccurate | Improved | Reason // أُحِبُّ السَّفَرَ وَهُوَ مُكْلِفٌ. | أُحِبُّ السَّفَرَ، لَكِنَّهُ مُكْلِفٌ. | contrast, not simple addition // تَأَخَّرْتُ لِذَلِكَ فَاتَتْنِي الْحَافِلَةُ. | تَأَخَّرْتُ، لِذَلِكَ فَاتَتْنِي الْحَافِلَةُ. | clear cause → result boundary // لَمْ أَذْهَبْ لِأَنَّ كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا. | لَمْ أَذْهَبْ لِأَنَّنِي كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا. | build the لأنّ clause with its subject // دَخَلْتُ ثُمَّ وَجَدْتُهُ أَمَامِي فورًا. | دَخَلْتُ فَوَجَدْتُهُ أَمَامِي فَوْرًا. | immediate next event suits فـ
## Grammar game
Identify the logical relationship and choose the connector that expresses it.
## Skills workshop التَّطْبِيقُ الْعَمَلِيُّ
Improve a repetitive paragraph and extend spoken answers with precise links.
[ar] أُفَضِّلُ التَّعَلُّمَ فِي الْفَصْلِ لِأَنَّنِي أَتَفَاعَلُ مَعَ الْمُعَلِّمِ، لَكِنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ عَنْ بُعْدٍ أَكْثَرُ مَرُونَةً.
[ar] كَانَ الطَّقْسُ سَيِّئًا، لِذَلِكَ بَقِينَا فِي الْبَيْتِ، ثُمَّ شَاهَدْنَا فِلْمًا.
### Upgrade a simple paragraph
Write 90–110 Arabic words comparing two ways of travelling, learning, shopping or spending free time.
[callout] Success checklist: Use وَ and أَوْ only where logical; include ثُمَّ or فَـ; include لَكِنْ/ولكنّه; include a reason with لِأَنَّ and a consequence with لِذَلِكَ or لِذَا.
[callout] Paper route: Write a first draft using only short sentences. Then join the ideas with connectors and annotate the function above each connector.
## Final mastery check
Check addition, sequence, contrast, reason and result.
### What you can now do
- Choose a connector by logical function.
- Distinguish ثُمَّ from immediate فَـ.
- Build contrast with لَكِنْ and reason with لِأَنَّ.
- Link cause to consequence with لِذَلِكَ or لِذَا.
Spaced revisit: Return in two or three days and complete the final check again without looking at the tables.
